properties.Description: Describes the connected cluster resource properties.

identity.Description: The identity of the connected cluster.

location.Description: The geo-location where the resource lives

systemData.Description: Azure Resource Manager metadata containing createdBy and modifiedBy information.

agentPublicKeyCertificate.Description: Base64 encoded public certificate used by the agent to do the initial handshake to the backend services in Azure.

kubernetesVersion.Description: The Kubernetes version of the connected cluster resource

totalNodeCount.Description: Number of nodes present in the connected cluster resource

totalCoreCount.Description: Number of CPU cores present in the connected cluster resource

agentVersion.Description: Version of the agent running on the connected cluster resource

provisioningState.Description: Provisioning state of the connected cluster resource.

distribution.Description: The Kubernetes distribution running on this connected cluster.

distributionVersion.Description: The Kubernetes distribution version on this connected cluster.

infrastructure.Description: The infrastructure on which the Kubernetes cluster represented by this connected cluster is running on.

managedIdentityCertificateExpirationTime.Description: Expiration time of the managed identity certificate

lastConnectivityTime.Description: Time representing the last instance when heart beat was received from the cluster

connectivityStatus.Description: Represents the connectivity status of the connected cluster.

privateLinkState.Description: Property which describes the state of private link on a connected cluster resource.

privateLinkScopeResourceId.Description: This is populated only if privateLinkState is enabled. The resource id of the private link scope this connected cluster is assigned to, if any.

azureHybridBenefit.Description: Indicates whether Azure Hybrid Benefit is opted in

aadProfile.Description: AAD profile for the connected cluster.

arcAgentProfile.Description: Arc agentry configuration for the provisioned cluster.

securityProfile.Description: Security profile for the connected cluster.

oidcIssuerProfile.Description: Open ID Connect (OIDC) Issuer Profile for the connected cluster.

gateway.Description: Details of the gateway used by the Arc router for connectivity.

arcAgentryConfigurations.Description: Configuration settings for customizing the behavior of the connected cluster.

miscellaneousProperties.Description: More properties related to the Connected Cluster

enableAzureRBAC.Description: Whether to enable Azure RBAC for Kubernetes authorization.

adminGroupObjectIDs.Description: The list of AAD group object IDs that will have admin role of the cluster.

tenantID.Description: The AAD tenant ID to use for authentication. If not specified, will use the tenant of the deployment subscription.

desiredAgentVersion.Description: Version of the Arc agents to be installed on the cluster resource

agentAutoUpgrade.Description: Indicates whether the Arc agents on the be upgraded automatically to the latest version. Defaults to Enabled.

systemComponents.Description: List of system extensions that are installed on the cluster resource.

agentErrors.Description: List of arc agentry and system components errors on the cluster resource.

agentState.Description: Represents the current state of the Arc agentry and its dependent components.

userSpecifiedVersion.Description: Version of the system extension to be installed on the cluster resource.

majorVersion.Description: Major Version of the system extension that is currently installed on the cluster resource.

currentVersion.Description: Version of the system extension that is currently installed on the cluster resource.

component.Description: Agent component where error message occured.

enabled.Description: Whether to enable or disable the workload identity Webhook
Whether to enable oidc issuer for workload identity integration.

issuerUrl.Description: The issuer url for hybrid clusters connected to Arc used for the workload identity feature.

selfHostedIssuerUrl.Description: The issuer url for public cloud clusters - AKS, EKS, GKE - used for the workload identity feature.

enabled.Description: Indicates whether the gateway for arc router connectivity is enabled.

feature.Description: Specifies the name of the feature for the configuration setting.

settings.Description: The configuration settings for the feature that do not contain any sensitive or secret information.

protectedSettings.Description: The configuration settings for the feature that contain any sensitive or secret information.

principalId.Description: The principal id of connected cluster identity. This property will only be provided for a system assigned identity.

tenantId.Description: The tenant id associated with the connected cluster. This property will only be provided for a system assigned identity.

type.Description: The type of identity used for the connected cluster. The type 'SystemAssigned, includes a system created identity. The type 'None' means no identity is assigned to the connected cluster.

createdBy.Description: The identity that created the resource.

createdByType.Description: The type of identity that created the resource.

lastModifiedBy.Description: The identity that last modified the resource.

lastModifiedByType.Description: The type of identity that last modified the resource.

lastModifiedAt.Description: The timestamp of resource last modification (UTC)

clientProxy.Description: Boolean value to indicate whether the request is for client side proxy or not

hybridConnectionConfig.Description: Contains the REP (rendezvous endpoint) and “Sender” access token.

expirationTime.Description: Timestamp when this token will be expired.
